t:
Write detailled spec for an web application that allow to create architecture diagram like icepanel (https://icepanel.io/).
This means:
* Editable/animated diagrams
* WYSIWYG editor (drop components, link component, add/edit properties) like icePanel *but* allow user to access a code view of the diagram
* All storage should be in browser session - nothing server side
* User should be able to download/upload file
* Diagram should be based on mermaid approach, with possible extensions - at minimal the tool should be able to open/convert mermaid
* Visual attractive - should allow animation/flows visualisation
* Code of the app must follow SOLID and complexity should be verified with cyclo and static analysis check - unit tests coverage must be planned - all dev must also be tested end-2-end with browser + visually validated with vision to ensure correct style - use minimal external dependencies if the functional need can be met with standard library - you are allowed to use libraries/framework if they allow simplified code/avoid extreme complexities.
* The tool should allow multiple file - the user should be able to create a directory structure. in addition of per file import/export - the tool should allow a full zip download.
* Maintain an agents.md and complete documentation - focus on agentic dev solution but document *must* be human readable.
* Tool will be hosted on https://github.com/pijalu/panelcraft - if the tool can be *fully* hosted on a github page, it's a plus
* The build should create a single golang bin for windows/linux/mac that can serve the complete application

Review/research the project - ask clarification as needed
Static server + headless CLI for render/validation/lint of diagrams
note: Don't document the link to ice-panel in documentation
file do not have to be compatible with mermaid - the grammar can be inspired - export could export to mermaid (with drop of features)
A key point: All architecture document of panelcraft should be written in panelcraft
make sure panelcraft does *not* have any external dep (CDN and co) - the build must be complete / runnable without internet
plan the complete execution using goal - focus on LLM context optimization
